purpose: Recover the complete capability, pain, consumer, and retirement lineage before another architecture migration. This registry prevents carrier deletion from being mistaken for authority cleanup or capability restoration; it never selects a task, domain route, tool, worker, or completion state.

frozen_baseline.reason: The current user explicitly accepts the restored basic source-aware human-utterance decoder. That acceptance does not imply that the distinct historical semantic-scope-fidelity capability was restored; the newly observed parent-to-foundation compression is handled as a separate family without rewriting source classification.

required_before_removing_or_colding_a_ca: name the historical pain and causal work the carrier served
name every still-relevant capability family that intersects the carrier
bind each retained family to a current consumer and observable readback
give each retired family a named harm, recovery handle, and explicit no-hot-restore boundary
preserve a reversible recovery path for cold or uncertain capabilities
run this lineage preflight plus the intersecting deterministic and fresh behavior consumers

selection_order: bind the human source, complete intent envelope, object, authority, and completion ruler
resolve only capabilities relevant to that bound frame from hot metadata, conditional Skills, cold overlays, and live route facts
execute through the smallest reversible surface with typed identity, isolation, recovery, and Stop boundaries
keep worker terminal, Owner adoption, authority application, effect readback, and parent completion distinct
return from bounded work to every residual open parent dimension
learn only through evidence-bound regression and capability-lineage migration preflight

families.pain: Quoted material, the latest sentence, a report title, cwd, STATUS, or a complete imperative can be mistaken for the human's adopted parent task.
families.causal_work: Decode source and conversational act, bind the active object and parent result, then let domain or engineering knowledge complete only the means.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Always-hot text has global semantic radius; expansion can recreate literal matching or a rule stack.
families.rollback: Revert only an isolated new behavior delta; retain the accepted source-aware decoder and its changed-context cases.
unknowns: No finite suite proves correct frame binding on every future tool path.

families.pain: A complete user-owned outcome can be lossily compressed into the first tractable guard, shared generator, report, or local green result, leaving the user to recover every omitted dimension.
families.causal_work: Preserve the full adopted outcome envelope and residual open dimensions after source binding; let a local item occupy the action slot without rewriting parent completion identity, and honor an explicit human scope reduction when it really occurs.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Always-hot semantic scope has global radius; the thin invariant must preserve legitimate explicit narrowing and avoid storing a full task graph on every turn.
families.rollback: Revert only the semantic-fidelity delta if it blocks an explicit human scope change; retain source-aware admission and the paired preserve-versus-explicit-reduction cases.
unknowns: The paired changed-surface fresh outputs pass the current semantic-effect oracle and A/B hot carriers are byte-identical; only later natural recurrence can establish parent-level burden reduction across arbitrary work.

families.pain: Window, compact, child insertion, worker terminal, local completion, or interruption can erase the exact parent slot or manufacture a new task from observed state.
families.causal_work: Rebind at lifecycle and control-transfer events; preserve an exact return point only when one exists; fail open to current words rather than synthesize a task.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: A resident continuation controller can seize task authority; advisory lifecycle hooks and typed action receipts have smaller radius.
families.rollback: Remove only the failing advisory projection or binding; never restore the retired PreToolUse permission gate or science-bearing predecision injection.
unknowns: Natural long-horizon compact and arbitrary interruption recurrence remain only partially sampled.

families.pain: The first defensible action can end search too early: ask instead of infer, defer despite an available action, continue after Pause, or stop after local green.
families.causal_work: At high-leverage transfer points compare the nearest fact-live symmetric alternatives and preserve real user-only or irreversible boundaries without approval theater.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Full enumeration on every turn is expensive and rigid; event-bounded reasoning plus paired regressions is the thin form.
families.rollback: Remove an over-rigid case or hook branch while retaining Pause/Stop and major-effect boundaries.
unknowns: User Pause is a hard semantic boundary but has no universal machine-readable freeze bit across every tool surface.

families.pain: The system can hand technical preparation back to the user, stop at a report, or hand-roll a second runtime before checking mature capabilities.
families.causal_work: Compile the real user outcome into a full product operation, search mature surfaces first, bind only the needed parameters, invoke the real consumer, and return to the parent activity.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Open-world search and live invocation are costly; they should trigger only where reuse can change the implementation route.
families.rollback: Reject a candidate mature surface and fall back to the smallest local implementation without changing the parent result.
unknowns: Current public alternatives drift and require fresh primary-source verification.

families.pain: Sole Owner was confused with sole labor, while worker terminal, model identity, or agreement could be confused with adoption and completion.
families.causal_work: Dispatch separable positive-value labor, keep Codex in direct contact with the real object, and separate candidate, Owner adoption, effect, and parent completion.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Fan-out spends independent quota and creates Owner fan-in burden; auto-adoption would have parent-wide failure radius.
families.rollback: Reject or quarantine a candidate receipt; never translate accepted worker execution into Owner adoption.
unknowns: External WorkerPool has strong terminal receipts but no universal automated Owner-adoption consumer by design.

families.pain: A quota query, provider drift, seal mismatch, one lane failure, or local wait can poison the whole parent or silently switch transport.
families.causal_work: Cache bounded routing facts, fail closed on identity drift, isolate only the dependency cone, and reroute only on an explicit fact-backed event.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Deterministic code is cheaper and safer than live language cases; a bad route event should affect only its dispatch cone.
families.rollback: Retain the last hash-bound route receipt or choose another healthy route without altering the parent task.
unknowns: Current provider behavior and quota catalogs remain time-specific.

families.pain: A callback, file, test, receipt, or accepted attempt can be reported as a landed effect or parent completion without physical readback.
families.causal_work: Bind work key, effect identity, attempt receipt, replay state, Owner verdict, and original-consumer readback as separate evidence.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Receipts add bounded engineering cost; promoting unused legacy consumers would recreate a platform with no parent benefit.
families.rollback: Mark the exact consumer partial or rejected and preserve the prior physical state; do not repair by changing parent semantics.
unknowns: Several registered legacy or durable consumers still have no current fresh canary.

families.pain: Recurring AI pain can be forgotten, while one-off wording or temporary task state can be over-promoted into permanent rules.
families.causal_work: Turn stable cross-context failures into source-aware cases and real consumers; keep personal judgment lineage conditional and overridable by current words.
families.cost_and_failure_radius: Always loading personal lineage or auto-promoting failures would bias every task; conditional retrieval keeps the radius local.
families.rollback: Demote or remove a bad candidate/case; current words and live facts always override stored shaping evidence.
unknowns: Long-horizon reduction in repeated user correction is observable only through future natural recurrence.

families.cost_and_failure_radius: Always-on GUI, memory, and hook surfaces have prompt/process cost, but colding them can remove unique live capabilities; native multi-agent remains cold by default.
families.rollback: Use task-scoped overrides and restore base config; A/B remain one work shape.

families.rollback: Stop only the exact task-scoped carrier and retain direct execution; do not change the parent task or revive an old episode.
